notes.claim: A coil and its contacts may appear on different pages or rungs, so they are matched by reference designation and cross-reference information.
A normally closed contact is drawn closed even when, in normal running, its coil is energised and the contact is open.
Permissive contacts are wired in series, so that if any one of them detects an unsafe condition, the circuit is opened.

sources.title: Electrical Symbols Chart: ANSI vs IEC Industrial Control Symbols
sources.quote: The coil and its contacts may appear on different pages or in different ladder-diagram rungs. Match them using the reference designation and cross-reference information. Do not assume two similarly shaped coils belong to the same device.
